evidence.name: South Shore Line — Kensington entry to Metra tracks
Metra Electric main line and Blue Island Branch

why: Which of two lines sharing one physical track is DRAWN and which is drawn from the other's alignment. build-display-lanes.mjs discovers this by measurement everywhere it can, but measurement alone cannot separate the two things japan_line_by_line_audit/02 separates by hand: 342 spans of 坐标精确重合 (exact coordinate coincidence, median lateral 0.0 m — one physical track digitised twice) from 245 spans of 真实几何平行 (genuinely independent centrelines on their own roadbeds). 35 of those 245 run closer than FOLLOW_MAX_MEDIAN_METRES and all 245 are longer than FOLLOW_MIN_RUN_METRES, so an unaided measurement pass would draw 35 independent railways off a neighbour's centreline.

So under the route-preserving profile (jp-render-groups.json) a follow needs a reviewed reason as well as a measurement, and this table is that reason. Only the coincident pairs are seeded; not one of the 245 true-parallel spans appears here, and each of those keeps its own centreline and takes a parallel lane instead.

Entries are recorded per CLASS — `tenantLineIds` / `landlordLineIds` list every geometry-part row (-2/-3/-p1 …) on each side — because the relationship is between two railways, not between two of their parts.
displayLandlordPolicy.method: japan_line_by_line_audit/02_共线与平行区间明细.csv rows of type 坐标精确重合, adjudicated into tenant/landlord by jp-corridor-landlords.csv (N02 rank, then operator tier, then digitised length). 62 of that file's 113 rows are UNRESOLVED and are not seeded; 51 rows resolved, expanding to the directed class pairs below because a row may name several lines on one side.

unresolved.why: The reviewed rows contradict each other on direction: one row makes the first line the landlord over one span and another makes it the tenant of the second over an adjacent span. A landlord seed that names both directions is not evidence, so neither direction is seeded and the pair falls back to the ordinary lane pass. jp-corridor-landlords.csv itself flags the 信越線/羽越線 adjudication as low confidence and asks for an N02 track-ownership review; the 京成成田空港線/北総線 pair needs the same, since Narita Sky Access genuinely changes which company owns the track along its length.
